event.odalys_heart2.0.text: Sit. No, stand. Wrist, [player]. You walked in without a single complaint. In this clinic, that is an anomaly.
event.odalys_heart2.0.why: ends on the clinical word; the welcome hides in the diagnosis

event.odalys_heart2.1.text: Sixty-two, steady. The fields are doing half my job. I'll allow it.
event.odalys_heart2.1.why: a real number beats 'strong'; professional jealousy as warmth

event.odalys_heart2.2.text: Two salads, then. At a table, on a chair, in daylight. Doctor's orders.
event.odalys_heart2.2.why: the triple condition is the joke; catchphrase lands last

event.odalys_heart2.4.text: Half of Wetherell eats standing up. I keep a list. You have just been crossed off it.
event.odalys_heart2.4.why: the list is a thread; being crossed off it is the gift

event.odalys_heart5.1.text: I copied one out for you. The forager's plate: hedge greens, mushrooms, a little salt. Eaten sitting down. We've discussed this.

event.odalys_heart5.3.text: Edmund has a page in here. That last fall he followed every instruction exactly. He never had before. ...Tidy, at the end.
event.odalys_heart5.3.why: sharper Edmund thread: the change is the mystery, cozy-safe

dlg.story.pie.talk.r1b.text: Cinnamon, added late and not by the baker. It's better now. I resent the improvement, professionally.
dlg.story.pie.talk.r1b.why: she reads the pie like a chart; funniest word last

event.odalys_heart8.intro.text: Sit. The clinic is closed; I closed it, deliberately, while no one was ill. I'm taking my own prescription tonight: soup, and company. My supplies of both are low.
event.odalys_heart8.intro.why: 'while no one was ill' is the confession; stock metaphor carries the loneliness

dlg.odalys.office.0.text: I prescribe rest to everyone. I have never once swallowed the dose myself. This is unfamiliar. Be gentle.
dlg.odalys.office.0.why: the dose metaphor makes the hypocrisy clinical, not sad

dlg.odalys.office.1.text: So, [player]. The patient is stubborn, overdue, and out of excuses. Your recommendation?
dlg.odalys.office.1.why: she hands over the role; 'recommendation' opens the choices

dlg.odalys.office.c0.text: Insist she rests tonight, no appeals.

dlg.odalys.office.c2.text: Write her a prescription for once.
dlg.odalys.office.c2.why: 'for once' sets up r2: she has never been given one

dlg.odalys.office.r1.text: Two spoons, one pot. The entire course of treatment. You diagnosed me in one visit. It took me years.
dlg.odalys.office.r1.why: 'years' is the true word and goes last

event.odalys_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday. I observe it annually, with soup. Consider this an invitation, not an order. For once.
event.odalys_birthday.intro.why: 'annually' is the deadpan; 'for once' winks at doctor's orders

event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l2.text: Elara. The stool is wearing a cozy. I noticed on Tuesday. It stays; wool aids recovery.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l2.why: she has known for days and said nothing; approval as medicine

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l2.text: Seven vegetables. I'll need the surprise identified before anyone swallows it. Professionally.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l2.why: repeats Elara's word, demands the surprise like a diagnosis

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l2.text: You counted wrong. It was twelve. ...The mask is very soft. Ten minutes, after lunch. Once.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l2.why: precision outranks self-preservation: she corrects the count against herself

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l1.text: Ione. The library lamps were lit an hour past closing on Thursday. I keep records.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l1.why: a specific day, and 'records' hands Ione her counterpunch

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l3.text: Patients keep odd hours. Books do not. ...Neither point survives examination. A draw.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l3.why: she concedes in clinical language; 'draw' lands last

event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.text: A tea that calms a stove. I'll want the leaf's name for my notebook. Pass the cup.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.why: remedy notebook callback instead of a sideways Hazel joke

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_1.l1.text: Marcus. You lifted that beam alone. I saw it from the clinic window. It's in your file.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_1.l1.why: 'your file' is funnier and more her than 'wrote it down'

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l4.text: ...Five minutes, then. Strictly for the bench's health. Elara is not to hear of this.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l4.why: she adopts Marcus's logic so the sitting isn't for her

threads.odalys_heart2: Dr. Penn keeps a list of everyone in Wetherell who eats standing up, and she is working through it.
threads.odalys_heart5: Why Edmund suddenly followed every instruction that last fall — tidy, at the end — is left hanging in her notebook.
threads.odalys_heart8: The soup is written up as 'repeat weekly', and it was not a question; a standing appointment now exists.
threads.odalys_birthday: The file labeled 'Unexpected' was empty last winter and is filling now.
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_1: A spare cozy waits for laundry day, and clinic policy now exists to be tested.
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_2: A bowl of the seven-vegetable soup is saved for Dr. Penn, and the turnip's disguise holds.
threads.overheard_elara_odalys_3: Whether ten minutes after lunch quietly becomes a habit, under Elara's count.
threads.overheard_marcus_odalys_2: Dr. Penn will sit on the bench five minutes, strictly for the bench's health, if Elara never hears.

notes: Kept dlg.odalys.birthday.0 ('You stayed. I have no protocol for this.') verbatim, but it also shipped as a daily line; the Director may want it to live in only one place.
overheard_elara_odalys_3: my l2 now corrects Elara's 'eleven hours' to twelve; if Elara's writer changes her number, mine must stay one hour worse than her count.
heart5's Edmund line is that scene's single thread; heart8's r0, r2 and both {if} wrap-ups, and pie r0b/r2b, I could not beat and kept as written.
